environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as container with default security context. No AppArmor or SELinux profile applied. Pod spec uses `securityContext: {}` with no `appArmorProfile` annotation. The container runs as uid 1000 but /var/lib/docstore/ and /etc/shadow are world-readable due to a misconfigured base image (alpine with permissive defaults). Service is exposed via ClusterIP with no network policy restricting inter-pod traffic.
